A new Fighter starts with four items: a Longsword, a Shield, a Potion of Healing and a pack of torches. The torches are stored in the database as `Torchx5`.

**Where it's defined**
- The item IDs are in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` at `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`. The Fighter entry is `[2, 15, 17, 23]` at line 66.
- `grantStartingEquipment` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:74`) inserts one row per ID into `character_inventory`, with `quantity` 1 and `equipped` 0. None of the items start equipped.
- The names come from `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Each `items` row gets an autoincrement ID in insert order.

| ID | Item name in `seed.sql` | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Longsword | weapon, 1d8, +2 attack |
| 15 | Shield | armor, +2 AC |
| 17 | Potion of Healing | potion, heals 2d4+2 |
| 23 | `Torchx5` (the docs call it "Torches") | misc |

The comment on line 66 of `character.ts` says `// Longsword, Shield, Potion, Rations`. That is wrong, because `23` is `Torchx5`. Rations (1 day) is ID 24. `docs/flows/character-creation.md` records this mismatch as bug B-09.

The docs and the code agree on all of this. I read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/flows/character-creation.md` and `docs/code/worker/src/db/seed.md`, then checked the code and `seed.sql` directly. I did not create or modify any files.
